name: feedback
description: Feedback from the people who use the app: a Feedback button on every page, in production too, that lets them pinpoint the element they mean (or choose "Nothing specific") and send a note; the ACRYL frame shows the notes in the builder's left panel.
mount: add a row `- id: feedback` / `name: feedback` to blend.yaml BEFORE the `routes` row (its middleware adds one script tag to every HTML page the routes after it answer) and register it in src/app.ts: 'feedback': feedback
